title: 1801 Prairie's south side, from its 1965 photograph
items: The two tall stone chimneys over the W. W. Kimball house's south wall now carry their carved heads, a collar under a diamond-latticed stage and a heavy cap, on broader bases rising from the cornice, as Harold Allen's 1965 HABS photograph shows them.

The south wall breaks out in a two-storey canted bay with a column of transomed windows, drawn where the 1911 fire-insurance map puts it, and a tall hooded dormer stands on the slate roof between the chimneys.
